metadata.title: Logs
metadata.description: Understand and utilize the application logs of Capgo to diagnostics and track the action of your devices with the updates.

The raw Logs subtab provides a detailed history of update events and diagnostic information for your application. It is useful for confirming the device-level evidence behind an Insight, troubleshooting an update path, and understanding how devices interact with Capgo. Open an app, choose

Click a row to jump to the device detail page for its full history.
You can filter logs by a specific time period using the date picker:

props.alt: Date range picker for filtering logs

blocks.text: - Select common time ranges: Last 1h, 3h, 6h, or 12h
- Set a custom start time for the range
- Set a custom end time for the range
- Pick specific dates using the calendar view
Click "Select" to apply your chosen date range, or "Cancel" to dismiss the picker.
The Actions dropdown lets you filter logs by specific event types:

props.alt: Actions filter dropdown for filtering logs by event type

If this was accidental, allow dev updates or move this device to a dev-enabled channel. If this is intentional, keep this channel locked to release builds only.

In the console, compare device and bundle key IDs. If they differ, publish with the same key and matching CLI/plugin version; key encoding can differ between versions.
